clinician.trajectory_summary: A 25-year-old woman presented with multiple grouped itchy erythematous papules and nodules on the left temporo-occipital scalp with ulceration and bleeding after scratching. Baseline labs including CBC with eosinophils, renal function, IgE, HIV, and urinalysis were normal. Histopathology of scalp biopsy revealed vascular proliferation of variable-sized blood vessels lined by plump histiocytoid endothelial cells and inflammatory infiltrate with lymphocytes and eosinophils, consistent with ALHE. The histopathology also showed Demodex mite infestation in sebaceous ducts confirming scalp demodicosis. Treatment with cryotherapy and topical metronidazole gel resulted in marked clinical improvement within 7 weeks.
